final:
make_ids(n: int, seed: int) -> List[int] =
  pre n >= 0
  post out.len() == n
  ex make_ids(0, 7).len() == 0
  ex make_ids(3, 1).len() == 3
  ex make_ids(3, 1) == make_ids(3, 1)
  var xs: List[int] = []
  let base = seed % 1000000007
  for i in range(0, n)
    xs.append(base + i)
  xs
